content.short: Rubic is a multi-chain aggregator that combines DEXs and bridges to find the best swap routes for TON users.
content.description: Rubic is a comprehensive multi-chain tech aggregator that simplifies the process of swapping tokens across different blockchains. By integrating numerous decentralized exchanges (DEXs) and bridges, Rubic identifies the most efficient routes and the best exchange rates for users looking to move assets into or out of the TON blockchain. Its 'One-Click' cross-chain swap feature allows users to trade assets from over 70 chains in a single, secure interface, making Rubic a powerful tool for efficient cross-chain trading.
content.meta: Find the best cross-chain swap rates with Rubic. Aggregated DEXs and bridges for TON on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
